project.name: Zeno's Planner
project.projectStatement: Zeno's Planner is a lightweight, LLM-friendly project planning and orchestration tool that enhances human 'vibe coding' by maintaining long-term project memory, reducing context size, and ensuring consistency from vision through implementation. Conceptually inspired by Zeno's dichotomy paradox, the tool generates iterative gates (milestones) that progressively approach project completion, with each gate requiring human approval and automated quality checks.

gates.name: Gate 01: Core Infrastructure
gates.goal: Establish TypeScript project, CLI framework, SQLite schema, core utilities

gates.name: Gate 02: Zeno Engine & Gate Generation
gates.goal: Implement core gate decomposition, code analysis, zeno init, write-time analysis

gates.name: Gate 03: MCP Server & LLM Tool Integration
gates.goal: Build MCP server, tool registry, and LLM interaction layer

gates.name: Gate 04: Requirements & Database Layer
gates.goal: Implement requirements management, dependency tracking, and database layer

gates.name: Gate 05: Architecture & Diagram Generation
gates.goal: Generate architecture diagrams (Mermaid/DOT), system overview, data flow

gates.name: Gate 06: Multi-Repo & Subproject Detection
gates.goal: Detect repository boundaries, coupling metrics, multi-repo orchestration

gates.name: Gate 07: Proposal Generation & Management
gates.goal: Proposal lifecycle: generation, validation, approval workflow, phase enforcement

gates.name: Gate 08: Automated Validation & Quality Gates
gates.goal: Shell validation runner, audit trail, git worktrees, requirement transfer, E2E tests

gates.name: Gate 09: Human Approval & Rejection Workflow
gates.goal: Human approval gates, rejection with feedback, replan triggers
